Name: Sam Portrait and Sprite with a Beanie
Author: aachutes
Description:
This simple mod features a portrait change for Sam, where he is wearing a color adjusted version of his 1.6 winter outfit beanie in his every day outfit. This mod was intended to give Sam the full skater boy fantasy look.

The sprites that don't feature the hat include:
- Flower Dance Sprite
- Marriage Sprite
- Work Sprite

Manifest.Name: Sam With a Beanie
Manifest.Description: Gives Sam a beanie similar to the one in his 1.6 winter outfit.
Manifest.Author: aa_chutes
